name: Build: HDR rendering, tone mapping and bloom
body: Render the scene into a floating-point target, tone map it with an ACES-style curve and add bloom so emissive gems glow. Quality setting: bloom on/off and strength; tone mapping always on once HDR is on. One PR based on nox-proto, with before/after screenshots, a guide page and a decision.

comments.text: Built on branch claude/project-thread-0wnz8z; decision D-063, guide docs/bloom-and-tone-mapping.md. 200 of 200 programs pass with LANTERN_REQUIRE_GPU=1 on lavapipe. Not checked: Metal, real-GPU frame time. Waiting on review and Dean's merge.
